paper_title: On the Role of Model Prior in Real-World Inductive Reasoning
caption: Human pairwise comparison results on three datasets, showing preferences for hypotheses with, without demos, and cases where it was hard to tell the difference.
model_annotation: The chart represents the distribution of human preferences for hypotheses with and without demos (demonstrations) across three datasets: Truthful Review, Funny Reddit, and Unhealthy Comments. Each of the three pie charts has three slices, representing the categories "W/o Demos" (grey), "Hard to Tell" (blue), and "W/ Demos" (green). For Truthful Review, the proportions are approximately 43% for "W/o Demos", 22.9% for "Hard to Tell", and 34.1% for "W/ Demos". For Funny Reddit, the proportions are approximately 41.5% for "W/o Demos", 21.5% for "Hard to Tell", and 37.1% for "W/ Demos". For Unhealthy Comments, the proportions are approximately 37.8% for "W/o Demos", 27.4% for "Hard to Tell", and 34.8% for "W/ Demos". The percentage labels are shown inside each slice, and a legend is provided at the top, indicating the color for each category. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way across the charts.
